title: Card erratum / historical override
description: Records that a card behaved or read differently in the past than its modern EDOPro implementation, and how (or whether) the historical behaviour is reproduced. One file per card that ever needs historical consideration. A record with classification 'cosmetic' documents that NO override is needed — absence of a record means 'not yet reviewed', not 'no erratum'.

classification.description: functional: printed/official text change that alters behaviour — needs a historical card implementation. cosmetic: wording/PSCT modernisation only — modern script is period-correct. ruling: official interpretation changed with no text change — may need script or engine handling. engine: behaviour difference caused by rules-era interactions, handled by rule profiles rather than card overrides.

date_effective.description: When the NEW (post-change) text/ruling took effect, if known. Formats whose snapshot date is before this use the historical behaviour.

historical_text.description: Card text before the change, transcribed from a cited source. null while not yet transcribed — never paraphrase from memory.

summary.description: Plain-language description of the behavioural difference.

changes.description: Ordered oldest-to-newest. A card errata'd twice has two entries.

strategy.description: none-needed: modern implementation is period-correct (cosmetic). reuse-upstream: Project Ignis already ships a historical version (e.g. BabelCDB goat-entries.cdb) — reference it instead of duplicating. custom-script: this project must provide a historical passcode, database row and Lua script. unresolved: known difference, approach not yet decided.

historical_passcode.description: The custom card code of the historical implementation (upstream's code when strategy=reuse-upstream, ours when custom-script).

historical_variant_passcodes.description: Additional artwork-variant codes of the historical implementation (within +/-10 of historical_passcode), when upstream ships several arts.

upstream.description: Where the reused implementation lives, e.g. 'ProjectIgnis/BabelCDB goat-entries.cdb + ProjectIgnis/CardScripts'.

script.description: Path of the Lua script implementing the historical behaviour (upstream path or dist/scripts path).

tested.description: true once an executable regression test covers the historical behaviour.

applicable_formats_note.description: Optional prose note. Which formats actually use the historical version is COMPUTED by tooling from each change's date_effective vs the format snapshot date; it is not hand-listed here.
